lines.beaver: 이번 선거 공약 보셨어요? 말이 많더라고요.
lines.beaver_en: Did you see the campaign pledges this election? People are talking a lot.
lines.beaver_roman: ibeon seongeo gongyak bosyeosseoyo? mari manteoragoyo.
lines.learner: 네, 공약은 화려한데 실현 가능성은 낮아 보여요.
lines.en: Yes, the pledges are flashy, but they don't look very realistic.
lines.roman: ne, gongyageun hwaryeohande siryeon ganeungseongeun naja boyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Which pledge do you think is especially problematic?
lines.learner: 영토 분쟁을 협상으로 금방 끝내겠다는 거요.
lines.en: The one about ending the territorial dispute quickly through negotiation.
lines.roman: yeongto bunjaengeul hyeopsangeuro geumbang kkeunnaegetdaneun geoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Border issues are really complicated, after all.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 지금 정세가 불안정한데 너무 쉽게 말해요.
lines.en: Right. The political situation is unstable, yet he talks too lightly.
lines.roman: majayo. jigeum jeongsega buranjeonghande neomu swipge malhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, he's running, so let's have some hope.
lines.learner: 출마는 자유이되 유권자를 속여선 안 되죠.
lines.en: Running is his right, but he shouldn't deceive voters.
lines.roman: chulmaneun jayuidoe yugwonjareul sogyeoseon an doejyo.

lines.beaver_en: That candidate has an impressive past, though.
lines.learner: 독재 정권에 대항한 민주화 투쟁은 인정해요.
lines.en: I do respect his fight for democracy against the dictatorship.
lines.roman: dokjae jeonggwone daehanghan minjuhwa tujaengeun injeonghaeyo.

lines.learner: 과거는 존중하되 지금 공약은 따로 봐야죠.
lines.en: Respect the past, but judge today's pledges separately.
lines.roman: gwageoneun jonjunghadoe jigeum gongyageun ttaro bwayajyo.

lines.beaver: 다른 후보 쪽은 어때요? 거긴 좀 낫나요?
lines.beaver_en: What about the other candidate? Any better?
lines.beaver_roman: dareun hubo jjogeun eottaeyo? geogin jom nannayo?
lines.learner: 그쪽은 사회주의 색이 짙은데 계획이 없어요.
lines.en: That side leans strongly socialist, but has no plan.
lines.roman: geujjogeun sahoejuui saegi jiteunde gyehoegi eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The mood on the streets is heated these days.
lines.en: Rallies should be guaranteed, and there must never be oppression.

lines.beaver_en: Exactly. In the end, the voters will decide.
lines.en: Yes, we're not in an age ruled by a king.

lines.beaver_en: I enjoyed the talk. Be sure to vote.
lines.en: Sure, I'll compare the pledges carefully and vote.
